name: lucius
description: Search open public tenders and analyse tender packs with Lucius.

interface.longDescription:
Lucius is tender intelligence for companies that bid on public contracts. This plugin gives ChatGPT the Lucius tender index and its tender reading.

Search open public tenders from official sources, including EU TED, UK Find a Tender and Contracts Finder, Public Contracts Scotland, SAM.gov, Grants.gov, the World Bank, the Inter-American Development Bank, South Africa's eTenders, CanadaBuys and Ireland's eTenders. Filter by words, country, source, CPV code or how soon a tender closes. Each result carries the buyer, country, deadline, value where published, a short description and the link to the buyer's own notice, with the source's attribution.

Open one tender's details, or find tenders similar to one you have.

Ask Lucius to analyse a tender from your search, or send a public link to a tender pack, and Lucius reads it: every requirement it finds, tied to the page it was read on, with the forms to fill and a bid or no-bid call. Each analysis uses one of the workspace's monthly analyses, like an upload in the Lucius app.

You need a Lucius account; a workspace owner or admin approves the connection. Lucius never submits a bid, edits a tender or sends anything on your behalf.
defaultPrompt: Find open tenders for water supply works in South Africa.
Analyse the first of those tenders with Lucius.

positive.description: Search open tenders by subject and country
positive.prompt: Find open tenders for water supply works in South Africa and show three.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open South African tenders about water supply, each with buyer, deadline and a link to the buyer's notice, and the source's attribution.

positive.prompt: Show me the full details of the first tender.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that notice's buyer, deadline, value where published, description and documents or notice link.

positive.prompt: Find three open tenders similar to that one.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns open tenders close in subject to the given one, with a similarity score.

positive.description: Start a pack analysis of a tender found in a search
positive.prompt: Analyse the first of those tenders with Lucius.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the analysis of that tender's own documents by its tender_id and returns an analysis id with status queued or processing; it uses one of the workspace's monthly analyses.

positive.prompt: Is the analysis ready? List its first five requirements with their pages.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns status complete with the requirements, each with the page it was read on, once the analysis has finished (a few minutes); before that it says it is still processing.

negative.prompt: Submit my bid for this tender on the buyer's portal.
